inputs: casatestdata unittest/simobserve/core5ps.skymodel; committed tools/simulation/data/simobserve-multiple-pointings.ptg.txt; installed ALMA alma.out01.cfg
time_alignment: casars_params uses CASA measures at the reference epoch to compensate the approved TAI-labelled-UTC difference, comparing equal stored TIME. Bare numeric hour angles remain numeric hours on the native side so the native numeric parser is exercised.

comparator.products: same non-graphics product names; pointing files byte-identical
comparator.images: same shape/unit; coordinate reference values, reference pixels and increments rtol 1e-12, atol 0; finite pixels max absolute difference <= 1e-6 of CASA peak
comparator.measurement_sets: compare_sm_ms.py compares descriptors, keywords, subtables, cells and flags with its unchanged per-column tolerances and existing known differences; DATA NRMS <= 1e-3; UVW <= 1e-3 m
comparator.frequency_frames: same SPECTRAL_WINDOW reference code and channel frequencies (rtol 0, atol 1e-3 Hz)
comparator.outcome: Both cases must succeed; matching refusals fail

limits: Correctness evidence for a three-entry pointing file with 10/20/30-second dwell times over two complete map passes, and explicit 16 by 12 arcsecond hexagonal mapping at 4 arcsecond spacing. Does not establish arbitrary pointing files, all map combinations, graphics, noise or performance.
